title: Arthur C. Clarke's Sri Lanka mountain portal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Arthur C. Clarke's Sri Lanka mountain portal, about 1970s at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He he wrote a book about a portal in Sri Lanka on the top of a mountain.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Arthur C. Clarke, the science fiction writer, wrote a book about a portal on top of a mountain in Sri Lanka. Michels brings it up while talking about strange experiences and other worlds, as if the writer had touched on something more than fiction.
